QuestInfo.name: [Reputation] The Tabloids Strike!
QuestInfo.1: A star's reputation is their life. Teach those Star Paparazzi a lesson for taking humiliating pictures of Lilin, and bring her those pictures!
QuestInfo.2: Good thing you eliminated those Star Paparazzi. Her pictures were embarrassing, but that won't stop you from being Lilin's biggest fan!

0.0: It's a disaster, #b#h0##k! Lilin was coming home from practice yesterday, when the #rStar Paparazzi#k took a humiliating picture of her. I mean, I don't know how bad the picture is, but a star's image is her life! If Lilin wants to be the Maple Rising Star, we have to do something!
0.1: We must get that picture back, before it's used to harm her image. There's no time to lose! You're ready to help, right?\r\n

yes.0: The #rStar Paparazzi#k sometimes appear #bin the fields nearby the towns#k in Maple World. Well anyway, show them a lesson if you see them. And your mission will be complete if you bring back the #bHumiliating Picture Film#k!

no.0: How can you abandon her in a moment like this? What is wrong with you?

npc.0: Bring the Humiliating Picture Film to Lilin as quickly as possible!

item.0: Check again to see if those Star Paparazzi have the Humiliating Picture Film.
